title: Fit-LRP: Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes for Neural Network Verification over Non-Convex Regions
abstract: arXiv:2611.16003v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: State-of-the-art neural network verifiers evaluate linear relaxations over axis-aligned bounding boxes. However, verification domains in cyber-physical systems are rarely boxes. Reachability specifications, obstacle-avoidance constraints, and neural Lyapunov certificates typically yield oblique or non-convex polyhedral regions, over which box-based bounds become extremely loose. This paper proposes Fit-LRP (Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes), a framework the implements exact optimization of affine bounds over non-convex domains (represented by unions of polytopes) by solving a sequence of small, low-dimensional linear programs. Our approach seamlessly enhances the final optimization step of LiRPA and $\alpha,\! \beta$-CROWN branch-and-bound (BaB) algorithms. translated_title: Fit-LRP：将线性松弛拟合到多面体以实现非凸区域上的神经网络验证
translated_abstract: 最先进的神经网络验证器在轴对齐边界框上评估线性松弛。然而，信息物理系统中的验证域很少是框形区域。可达性规范、避障约束以及神经Lyapunov证书通常会产生倾斜或非凸的多面体区域，在这些区域上，基于边界框的界会变得极其宽松。本文提出了Fit-LRP（将线性松弛拟合到多面体），该框架通过求解一系列小型、低维的线性规划，在非凸域（由多面体的并集表示）上实现仿射边界的精确优化。我们的方法可以无缝增强LiRPA以及α,β-CROWN分支定界（BaB）算法的最后优化步骤。在BaB验证中，用轴对齐分割来近似倾斜约束会导致严重的组合爆炸，并存在不终止的风险。通过优化最终的仿射边界……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出Fit-LRP框架，通过求解一系列小型低维线性规划，在由多面体并集表示的非凸区域上精确优化仿射边界，可无缝集成到LiRPA和α,β-CROWN算法中，从而避免轴对齐分割带来的组合爆炸问题，显著提升神经网络验证的紧致性与效率。
en_tdlr: Fit-LRP exactly optimizes affine bounds over non-convex regions (unions of polytopes) by solving sequences of small, low-dimensional linear programs, seamlessly enhancing LiRPA and α,β-CROWN branch-and-bound verification while avoiding the combinatorial blowup of axis-aligned splitting.
